programs.title: Direct Talk

programs.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Bustling Scenes of Old Tokyo
programs.desc: . We visit an Edo-style open-air teahouse, where the townspeople enjoyed refreshments, conversation, and the company of exotic birds. For them, these outings were about more than a good time.

programs.title: Today's Close Up
programs.desc: . An investigation into the rise of buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) services in Japan. We examine the risks of spiraling consumer debt, the lack of legal regulations and assess overseas legislation efforts. Hiroko Kuniya, Takeshige Morimoto.

programs.title: Document 72 Hours
programs.desc: , Episode 10, Season 14. Even as record-breaking snow blankets Kanazawa on the Sea of Japan coast, a car rental business stays open for its customers. For three days in January, we asked them where they will go and why. Masako Nishijima.
